[IDSP.1.2] **Typed arguments — no trampoline.** There is no
builtin trampoline and no argument-by-index decode. The Rete
evaluator produces each action's arguments as typed values
and hands the adapter a request struct (e.g.
`ds_rete_call_request_t { service, correlation, args, arg_count }`);
the bridge forwards them as the typed C parameters of the
public callback request type and of `ds_dispatcher_<verb>`.
Arg arity and types are fixed by the `Action` the compiler
emits in the rule's `TerminalNode` atom ([RDSC.4a.8]), not
re-validated at dispatch.
